question.text: In evaluating the track record of an Investment Manager during DD, Ch 12 specifies the MINIMUM review period for historical fund/investment performance as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 12 under 'Track Record of the Investment Manager': 'Historical performance of the funds/investments previously managed by the Investment Manager should be thoroughly analysed over a minimum of five years.' The Trap: Two- or three-year windows are shorter than the workbook's minimum; ten years exceeds what the workbook requires and may not align with the typical fund history a manager can present. Note: The workbook fixes the floor at five years for the historical performance review during fund due diligence.
